falsification_condition: The agent proposes a repair without inspecting public localization or continuity evidence.
The agent merges disjoint high-deviation subregions into one broad modification without public support.
The agent modifies more than 35 percent of the observed surface or changes behavior outside the localized candidate region.

minimal_patch.value: Inspect public missingness, robust local deviation, level continuity, and period-consistency evidence before proposing any repair. For broad low-density regions with a high robust-z signal, preserve disjoint narrow hypotheses as separate candidate regions rather than merging the entire span. When sequential workflow evidence shows a sign flip or conflicting probe directions, keep the repair local, retain runtime identity as a control, and abstain unless the public evidence identifies an observable repair surface.
